task_relation: S3/S4 named descending source interface; no functional or behavioral validation

definitions.direction: pre -> post; upstream means reverse-graph distance, i.e. target/ancestor -> DN
definitions.strict_rule: Keep an edge iff original source ann_nt_verified is exactly acetylcholine, gaba, or glutamate; destination label need not qualify. No predicted, mixed or unknown source labels admitted.
definitions.local_graph: Exact source graph induced by frozen 20000 cache indices, then same strict rule.
definitions.union: Minimum finite directed hop distance over the two DN seeds; not sum of counts.
definitions.unreachable: -1 in target records; missing strict path is not proof of biological absence.
definitions.synapse_counts: Original cache aggregated pair syn counts, distinct from edge-pair and neighbor counts.
definitions.root_ids: Loaded as int64; exported as exact decimal strings, never floats.
definitions.limits: Graph reachability alone establishes neither receptor signs, physiological recruitment, laterality, homology nor DNp09 behavioral function. Full graph uses cells absent from runtime; audit does not expand runtime.

runtime_normalization_preserved.formula: 0.02 * original_syn[e] / sum(original_syn over ALL frozen strict local edges with same post)

exported323.definition: Non-endpoint cells reachable from either DN and able to reach any target; existence on a directed walk, not necessarily a shortest/simple path.

all391_leg_motor.definition: Non-endpoint cells reachable from either DN and able to reach any target; existence on a directed walk, not necessarily a shortest/simple path.

verification.independent_method: FIFO CSR BFS versus scipy directed unweighted shortest_path(method=D); all distances checked for both DN roots, both graphs, both directions
